trustedServiceContextSignal.crossContextFailureRule: missing, unknown, changed, or config-derived context is startup-fatal; a production service can never downgrade to isolated/ordinary admission because of Kiosk config contents, and an isolated WO-03 instance can never gain production authority from a production-looking config

preRequestPreparationGate.runtimeImageBindingRule: the prepared isolated environment must be bound to the exact replacement immutable image ID and source revision frozen for PROD-11 before the authorization request

inside that same event transaction, re-evaluate STUDIO-PROD-01 resource-wide current selection and require KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID to be the unique current item with no competing active run or current candidate
inside that same event transaction, read the active Scheduling config and require businessTimeZone exactly Asia/Shanghai, matching the frozen Kiosk runtime businessTimeZone

/allowedBriefHosts.authorizationBinding: the exact final array and its canonical digest are frozen in the one-time PROD-11 authorization packet; any later requests_v2 brief_url change invalidates the gate and requires a fresh scan/review/rebinding before request or execution

filePayloadContract.materializationRule: replace the allowedBriefHosts placeholder with the exact authorization-bound reviewed array and replace both credential null placeholders with the exact generated canonical Base64 values; emit only the exact payload keys above; never copy deployment metadata into the JSON file; validate the final file through loadKioskRuntimeAuthV1 with VIEWER SUBMITTER SCHEDULER and ADMIN credential values supplied only as forbidden comparison inputs before atomic installation

credentialProvisioning.rawPasswordLifecycle: one-time operator-to-device provisioning; if lost, rotate by generating a new credential and config rather than recovering plaintext

replacementImageDeploymentAuthority.requiredAuthority: a separate explicit production deployment Action, distinct from PROD-11, bound to the exact frozen replacement immutable image ID/source revision and the existing production service/container topology

preserve the existing production data volume, loopback port, read-only rootfs, tmpfs, security options, restart policy, VCP configuration and DingTalk-disabled state
fresh-pass loopback/public health, production storage identity, VCP continuity and exact immutable image/revision verification before declaring the replacement deployment complete
bind KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION as the mandatory trusted production-service context while keeping KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH absent and all Kiosk writes disabled
replacementImageDeploymentAuthority.requiredRollback: the separate deployment Action must bind its own image/container rollback restoring the exact pre-replacement immutable runtime without deleting production data; ROLLBACK-10 is not image/container rollback authority
replacementImageDeploymentAuthority.completionRule: the separate deployment Action must complete and fresh-prove the live service is already running the exact replacement immutable image/revision with Kiosk still disabled before PROD-11 may be requested; fresh-prove KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION is present and immutable on the live service

prod11ConfigOnlyRecreation.purpose: apply/remove Kiosk startup-only configuration bindings after the exact replacement image has already been separately deployed

preservedExactly: production data volume identity and mount mode
all non-Kiosk runtime environment and mounts

prod11ConfigOnlyRecreation.postCreateProof: fresh inspect the recreated service and prove immutable image ID/source revision and every preserved topology field are unchanged, KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION, and only the frozen Kiosk bindings differ; if KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH is present, prove the exact frozen production identity was loaded, PROD11_SMOKE_ONLY was selected, and every required smoke binding passed startup validation before the listener became healthy

databaseWideBriefHostCompatibility.finalPreRequestRule: after every separately authorized pre-request scheduling/data preparation write has completed and immediately before PROD-11 authorization is requested, fresh-scan every requests_v2.brief_url in the live production database, reject invalid URLs, derive the exact sorted unique lowercase hostname set, explicitly review that set, bind the exact final allowedBriefHosts array and canonical digest into the one-time authorization packet, and materialize exactly that array into kiosk-auth.v1.json
databaseWideBriefHostCompatibility.staleOnChangeRule: any requests_v2 row insertion/update/delete or brief_url change after the final scan invalidates the compatibility proof and authorization binding; re-scan/review/rebind is mandatory

schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.requiredBeforeProd11Request: a separately authorized production scheduling preparation must create or fresh-confirm one exact canonical requests_v2 acceptance request, STUDIO-PROD-01, an active acceptance scheduling configuration whose businessTimeZone is exactly Asia/Shanghai, one canonical proposal acceptance that derives the acceptance schedule item, and the resulting schedule_item_tasks binding from that item to the exact V2 request

schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.canonicalTaskBindingRequirement: the schedule item must be created through canonical proposal acceptance so schedule_item_tasks binds exactly one acceptance request to the single acceptance schedule item; raw SQL insertion is forbidden
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.timeZoneBindingRule: the active acceptance scheduling config businessTimeZone must equal Asia/Shanghai exactly, matching the frozen Kiosk auth payload, before proposal generation and must be revalidated before PROD-11 Kiosk event execution

acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationPacketRule: before PROD-11 may be requested, bind an exact planned acceptanceRunStart and acceptanceRunEnd and fresh-prove the same derived schedule item is confirmed, unused, bound only to the exact canonical V2 acceptance request, and covers the whole planned run window with planned_start <= acceptanceRunStart < acceptanceRunEnd <= planned_end
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.authorizationExpiryRule: if current time reaches or passes planned_end before PROD-11 execution starts, or the item becomes used, cancelled, rebound, changed or no longer covers the bound acceptance run window, the authorization packet is stale and PROD-11 must not execute from it
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.executionTimeRecheck: after PROD-11 authorization, isolated WO-03 PASS, exact production Kiosk activation, and only on the frozen replacement runtime where KIOSK_TRUSTED_SERVICE_CONTEXT_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY proves immutable KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION and all four production-write capabilities are available, immediately before the first production smoke run event fresh-read the same schedule item, schedule_item_tasks binding and production_runs state and require confirmed status, exact STUDIO-PROD-01, exactly one binding to the frozen V2 acceptance request, zero prior runs, planned_start <= current time < planned_end, and planned_end still covers the bound acceptanceRunEnd
acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.failureRule: on any execution-time item, binding, run-state or resource-wide current-selection mismatch stop before the Kiosk run event; PROD-11 does not authorize creating or moving a replacement schedule item. acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.resourceWideSelectionRecheck: after isolated WO-03 PASS and exact production Kiosk activation, authenticated GET /api/v2/kiosk/current?resourceId=STUDIO-PROD-01 may be used as device-facing evidence only; it is non-authoritative for the write. acceptanceItemExecutionWindowContract.productionEventWriteGate: before the authenticated production current-selection recheck may be followed by any bounded PROD-11 smoke Kiosk run event, require WO03_EXACT_ISOLATED_ACCEPTANCE_ENVIRONMENT_BOUND, WO03_FULL_ISOLATED_VIEWPORT_AND_ON_SITE_MATRIX, REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE, OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT, KIOSK_TRUSTED_SERVICE_CONTEXT_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_SMOKE_BOUNDED_WRITE_ADMISSION_CAPABILITY, and KIOSK_SMOKE_OUTBOX_ISOLATION_CAPABILITY all PASS; KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT must equal PROD11_PRODUCTION; otherwise stop with zero production run-event writes and no real-provider delivery

unique current item for STUDIO-PROD-01 equals KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID and no competing active run or current candidate exists

allowedMutatingSequence.trustedServerTimeRule: inside the same trusted smoke write-admission/event transaction, after entering the write-serialization boundary and before any production fact commits, capture server time from the trusted runtime clock and require KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_START <= trustedServerTime <= KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_END

productionSmokeBoundary.idempotentReplayRule: exact replay of one of the two already-persisted phase commands is permitted only when the runId, eventId and command digest match the corresponding immutable receipt and produces no new production fact; replay does not advance the smoke phase or write budget
productionSmokeBoundary.dynamicTimeRule: command.occurredAt remains an untrusted client execution-time fact and must satisfy the frozen window plus the normal event-time policy. hardStopOutcomes: complete runId differs from the accepted start runId
ID structure invalid or secure-client generation proof unavailable
any non-RUN_EVENT_APPLIED response for a not-yet-persisted phase
unexpected pre-existing run/event/review/receipt/outbox facts inconsistent with the exact acceptance item or already-bound smoke identifiers
occurredAt before KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_START or after KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_END

terminalCondition.exactCondition: the complete event has an accepted immutable receipt with resultingState completed and runRevision 2 for the cryptographically generated runId bound by the accepted start receipt and KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID, after exactly the authorized start(localSequence 0) and complete(localSequence 1) mutations and no other accepted smoke mutation
evidenceRequired: exact start receipt, command digest, generated runId and generated start eventId
exact complete receipt, command digest and generated complete eventId

exactly two accepted smoke event facts for that bound run
no pending review for either bound smoke event ID
completion notification intent permanently isolated from real provider delivery
terminalCondition.afterTerminal: all further production Kiosk run-event writes remain denied under PROD-11 smoke authority; successful smoke completion does not grant normal-operation authority

writeAdmissionCapability.requirement: inside the same trusted write-admission/event serialization boundary, enforce the exact two-phase mutation budget, client-generated Web Crypto ID contract with immutable receipt binding, phase order, localSequence zero then one, expected revisions, schedule-item binding, immutable authorization-frozen smoke-window binding, both client occurredAt and in-transaction trusted server-time window predicates for every phase, no-third-write terminal latch, and receipt-exact replay-only exception
writeAdmissionCapability.clientCompatibility: must accept the existing reviewed Kiosk client's secureId('RUN') and secureId('EVENT') values and its queue sequence starting at zero; must not require predictable predeclared IDs
writeAdmissionCapability.windowBindingRequirement: replacement runtime must require immutable KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_START and KIOSK_SMOKE_ACCEPTANCE_RUN_END values copied exactly from the authorization packet and validate them at startup. For START and COMPLETE, after entering the same trusted write transaction/write-serialization boundary, capture trusted server time from the runtime clock and require both acceptanceRunStart <= trustedServerTime <= acceptanceRunEnd and acceptanceRunStart <= command.occurredAt <= acceptanceRunEnd before commit. The normal event-time policy remains additional validation and cannot substitute for trusted server-time admission.

outboxIsolationCapability.reason: the authorized complete event enqueues a production-run-completed notification intent; that acceptance-only intent must never later dispatch as a real provider notification
outboxIsolationCapability.requirement: before smoke write authority exists, freeze and implement a permanent exact-intent containment mechanism that preserves the audit/outbox fact but prevents real DingTalk or other provider delivery without affecting unrelated outbox facts

startPhaseBinding.runId: generated by the exact reviewed Kiosk client immediately before queue enqueue
startPhaseBinding.eventId: generated by the exact reviewed Kiosk client immediately before queue enqueue
startPhaseBinding.bindingRule: on the first valid start only, inside the same trusted smoke write-admission/event transaction, validate canonical ID structure and atomically bind the exact received runId and start eventId to the accepted immutable start receipt; no public constant or operator-chosen predictable identifier is authority

completePhaseBinding.runId: must equal the runId bound by the accepted start receipt
completePhaseBinding.eventId: new eventId generated by the exact reviewed Kiosk client with secureId('EVENT')
completePhaseBinding.bindingRule: on the one valid complete only, inside the same trusted smoke write-admission/event transaction, require the bound start runId, validate canonical event ID structure, and bind the exact received complete eventId to the accepted immutable complete receipt

executionGeneratedIdentifierContract.provenanceRule: the server cannot infer randomness from a string; Web Crypto provenance is established by exact-head client implementation/tests, while server admission validates structure, phase, identity, schedule binding, local sequence and immutable receipt/latch consistency
executionGeneratedIdentifierContract.replayRule: idempotent replay must reuse the exact runId/eventId already bound in the immutable receipt and the exact command digest

runtimeWindowBinding.equalityRule: container values must exactly equal the authorization-frozen acceptanceRunStart and acceptanceRunEnd
runtimeWindowBinding.transactionRule: for START and COMPLETE, after entering the same trusted write-admission/event transaction and before any production fact commits, capture trusted server time from the runtime clock; require acceptanceRunStart <= trustedServerTime <= acceptanceRunEnd and independently require acceptanceRunStart <= command.occurredAt <= acceptanceRunEnd
runtimeWindowBinding.trustedServerTimeSource: runtime-injected server clock captured only after entering the same event transaction/write-serialization boundary
runtimeWindowBinding.receiptTimestampRule: the accepted smoke receipt/audit timestamps must use the same trusted in-transaction server time that passed the frozen-window predicate

requiredProductionSmokeEvidence: exact production Kiosk identity binding and authenticated current-read path
exact confirmed unused production acceptance item is the current STUDIO-PROD-01 item immediately before any separately bounded production smoke run event
any production smoke run event is integration evidence only and cannot satisfy WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE or OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT
schedulableAcceptanceReadiness.productionSmokeSeparationRule: the separately authorized production scheduling preparation supports only a later bounded production integration smoke. Before PROD-11 production Kiosk activation, the complete isolated WO-03 REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT gates must pass. Before PROD-11 may even be requested, a replacement immutable image implementing KIOSK_TRUSTED_SERVICE_CONTEXT_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_SMOKE_BOUNDED_WRITE_ADMISSION_CAPABILITY, and KIOSK_SMOKE_OUTBOX_ISOLATION_CAPABILITY must be built, exact-head tested and frozen.

rollbackContract.rule: ROLLBACK-10 may disable the Kiosk configuration/device/trusted-identity mapping introduced by PROD-11 and may recreate the application container only on the exact same immutable image ID/source revision when required to remove startup-only Kiosk bind/env configuration. It never authorizes an image change and never deletes or rewrites production facts.
rollbackContract.afterAnyProd11FailureOrSubmission: preserve all accepted/review-required runs, reviews, receipts, audit and revision facts; remove/disable only the exact Kiosk auth configuration, credential/profile provisioning and trusted device/identity mapping introduced by PROD-11; if startup-only bindings require restart, recreate on the same immutable image while preserving all non-Kiosk topology/configuration exactly
rollbackContract.separateDeploymentRollbackRule: any change or rollback of the replacement application image ID/source revision belongs exclusively to the separately authorized replacement-image deployment Action and its own bound rollback; ROLLBACK-10 cannot select another image

requestability.wo03EvidenceSourceRule: REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT must come from the exact isolated WO-03 acceptance environment whose target and setup authority were frozen and completed before the PROD-11 request; the matrix executes only after authorization and before production Kiosk activation. Production smoke evidence remains separate and non-substitutable.
requestability.productionEventWriteGate: during the bounded PROD-11 production smoke only, no Kiosk run-event write may commit unless KIOSK_TRUSTED_SERVICE_CONTEXT_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_SMOKE_BOUNDED_WRITE_ADMISSION_CAPABILITY, and KIOSK_SMOKE_OUTBOX_ISOLATION_CAPABILITY all PASS. The trusted context capability must prove immutable KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION for the live service with no config/default fallback. The atomic context capability must prove the event target, immutable KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID binding, authorization-frozen derived scheduleItemId and unique current STUDIO-PROD-01 item are the same item and the active Scheduling config businessTimeZone equals Asia/Shanghai inside the same event transaction. The bounded write-admission capability must enforce the exact two-phase mutation budget, secure client IDs, zero-based local sequences, immutable smoke window and receipt-exact replay. The outbox isolation capability must prevent real provider delivery of the smoke completion intent. This smoke gate grants no authority for later unrelated production schedule items.

executionImageGate.rule: before PROD-11 may be requested, freeze and exact-head validate the replacement image with KIOSK_EVENT_ATOMIC_PRODUCTION_CONTEXT_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_SMOKE_BOUNDED_WRITE_ADMISSION_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_SMOKE_OUTBOX_ISOLATION_CAPABILITY, KIOSK_TRUSTED_SERVICE_CONTEXT_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY plus required immutable smoke-item/window bindings. The image must require the independent trusted KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT signal: PROD11_PRODUCTION for the live production service and WO03_ISOLATED_ACCEPTANCE for the isolated WO-03 environment, with no config-derived/default fallback. Then use a separate explicit production deployment Action to deploy that exact immutable image with KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION and Kiosk disabled. PROD-11 may later perform only the bounded same-image config-only recreate, preserving KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION; if KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH is enabled, there is no ordinary write-mode fallback.

atomicCapabilityPreRequestGate.requiredResolution: implement all atomic production-context predicates in the Kiosk event transaction, including immutable KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID startup binding and equality with the authorization-frozen scheduleItemId, exact-head test scheduling selection/time-zone/binding races, build a replacement production image, record immutable image ID/source revision, and update the PROD-11 deployment binding before requesting authorization
atomicCapabilityPreRequestGate.noPostAuthorizationImageSwap: PROD-11 authorization may not add capabilities after authorization and may not change the live application image ID/source revision. The separately authorized replacement-image deployment must already be complete before the PROD-11 request. PROD-11 may only perform the separately frozen same-image config-only container recreation needed to activate Kiosk startup bindings.
requiredAtomicPredicates: event schedule target equals immutable KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID and the authorization-frozen derived acceptance scheduleItemId
exact current-item uniqueness for STUDIO-PROD-01 equals KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID
active Scheduling config businessTimeZone equals Asia/Shanghai

requestability.productionActivationGate: after explicit PROD-11 authorization, execute and close isolated WO-03 on the same frozen image under KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=WO03_ISOLATED_ACCEPTANCE; only REAL_DEVICE_ACCEPTANCE=PASS and OFFLINE_REPLAY_RESULT=PASS permit the bounded same-image config-only recreation that enables the exact production Kiosk config on the live service, where KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT must already and still equal PROD11_PRODUCTION. Presence of KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH in production context unconditionally selects PROD11_SMOKE_ONLY and requires every frozen smoke binding/capability before listen.

preRequestRevalidationChecklist.freshnessRule: re-run the complete seven-check set immediately before PROD-11 authorization is requested; any missing, stale, changed or failed check leaves requestability blocked

postSmokeNormalOperationTransition.rule: PROD-11 must not be requested until a separate authority contract defines how the acceptance-smoke-only container transitions to normal Kiosk production authority without reusing KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID as a permanent item lock and without creating an unreviewed mutable per-item authority channel
forbiddenShortcuts: do not hot-reload or rotate KIOSK_SMOKE_EXPECTED_SCHEDULE_ITEM_ID
do not infer normal-operation authority from current database schedule items
do not treat successful PROD-11 smoke completion as blanket authority for later schedule items
do not silently recreate a normal-operation container without separately frozen authority

requestability.productionReadyClaimRule: neither successful isolated WO-03 nor successful bounded production smoke authorizes or proves normal ongoing Kiosk production operation; no production-ready or normal-operation claim is allowed until the separate post-smoke normal-operation transition authority is frozen and completed

preRequestIsolatedEnvironmentGate.rule: the exact isolated WO-03 environment and separately bounded setup authority must exist before the PROD-11 request; only the acceptance execution itself remains post-authorization

requiredAssertions: Greenfield authority validator PASS against the frozen parent manifest
completedAcceptanceIds still include PROD-GF-13-ACTIVATE, PROD-GF-14L-RESTORE-CLEANUP-RUNTIME-LIFECYCLE and PROD-10-ENABLE-VCP-REMOTE-SYNC
base INTEGRATION_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS is treated only through the Greenfield supersession contract, not its static base BLOCKED value
current Greenfield authority requestableActionIds explicitly contains PROD-11-ENABLE-KIOSK-IDENTITY-DEVICE before the human authorization request
currentAuthorityGate.failureRule: the local PROD-11 deployment freeze never self-authorizes or self-promotes requestability; if current Greenfield authority does not explicitly admit the exact PROD-11 action after all prerequisite evidence is fresh, no authorization request may be made

productionSmokeBoundaryGate.terminalRule: accepted complete receipt with resultingState completed and runRevision 2 closes all PROD-11 smoke write authority after exactly start localSequence 0 and complete localSequence 1 under the runId bound by the accepted start receipt; no third production Kiosk mutation is permitted
productionSmokeBoundaryGate.runIdRule: start generates RUN-{crypto.randomUUID()}; complete must reuse the exact runId bound by the accepted start receipt
productionSmokeBoundaryGate.eventIdRule: start and complete each generate EVENT-{crypto.randomUUID()}; each exact value becomes immutable only through its accepted phase receipt and must be reused unchanged for idempotent replay
productionSmokeBoundaryGate.occurredAtRule: both authorized smoke phases must satisfy the immutable authorization-frozen acceptance window inside KIOSK_SMOKE_BOUNDED_WRITE_ADMISSION_CAPABILITY before commit
productionSmokeBoundaryGate.trustedServerTimeGate: required: each START/COMPLETE transaction must capture trusted server time after entering the write boundary and prove it is inside the authorization-frozen acceptanceRunStart/acceptanceRunEnd window; command.occurredAt alone is never sufficient
productionSmokeBoundaryGate.modeActivationRule: KIOSK_TRUSTED_SERVICE_CONTEXT_SIGNAL_CAPABILITY must prove immutable KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION on the live service, independent of Kiosk config contents and smoke variables. With that production context, KIOSK_AUTH_CONFIG_PATH absent means Kiosk disabled; once the exact frozen production config is present and valid, authority becomes PROD11_SMOKE_ONLY and every other required smoke capability/binding remains mandatory. WO03_ISOLATED_ACCEPTANCE is valid only for the separately bounded isolated environment and never grants production write authority.

replacementImageDeploymentAuthorityGate.rule: PROD-11 does not authorize changing the live application image ID/source revision. Before PROD-11 may be requested, a separate explicit production deployment Action must deploy the exact frozen replacement immutable image with KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION, Kiosk config absent/disabled, and complete its own rollback/health/VCP/storage verification. After that, PROD-11 may only recreate the container on that same immutable image while preserving KIOSK_SERVICE_CONTEXT=PROD11_PRODUCTION to apply Kiosk startup configuration.
completionEvidence: exact separately authorized deployment Action ID and authority target
post-deployment live immutable image ID equals requestability.executionImageGate.finalImmutableImageId
Kiosk config/env/profile/credential still disabled or absent

databaseWideBriefHostGate.ordering: must run after all separately authorized pre-request writes that can create/update requests_v2 and before the human PROD-11 authorization request
databaseWideBriefHostGate.scanScope: every live production requests_v2.brief_url, scheduled or unscheduled
requiredProof: live production database identity and revision/freshness marker
canonical digest over the scanned request_id + brief_url set
exact sorted unique lowercase observed hostname set
explicit review result for every observed host
canonical digest of the final allowlist
proof every non-empty brief_url hostname is in the final allowlist and no unobserved extra host is present
databaseWideBriefHostGate.emptyArrayRule: allowed only when the final fresh scan observes zero non-empty brief URLs
databaseWideBriefHostGate.failureRule: invalid URL, unreviewed host, missing observed host, extra unobserved host, wildcard, stale scan, or post-scan requests_v2 mutation keeps PROD-11 non-requestable

prod11ExecutionAuthority.consistencyRule: once the replacement image is frozen and separately deployed, runtimeAuthorityBinding prod11ExecutionAuthority image/revision/tag, candidateImage.executionBinding final values, requestability.executionImageGate final values, isolated WO-03 runtime binding, diagnostic tag resolution, OCI revision label, and the live service image/container identity produced by the separate deployment Action must all identify the same immutable image and source revision; any disagreement is fail closed
prod11ExecutionAuthority.diagnosticTagDerivationRule: exact string jenn-shooting-operations:prod- followed by finalSourceRevision
prod11ExecutionAuthority.diagnosticTagAuthority: diagnostic only; never execution authority by itself
prod11ExecutionAuthority.tagResolutionRule: the separate deployment Action must verify the diagnosticTag resolves to immutableImageId and the image OCI revision label equals sourceRevision immediately before it creates/replaces the live service. PROD-11 may not change the application image ID/source revision, but may perform only the separately frozen same-image config-only container recreation needed to apply/remove Kiosk startup bindings while preserving all non-Kiosk topology/configuration exactly.

supersededBaseGateHandling.INTEGRATION_DEPLOYMENT_READINESS: must be interpreted through current Greenfield authority supersededBaseGateIds rather than re-imposed from the static base manifest

currentGreenfieldAuthority.requestRule: this contract can never make PROD-11 requestable by itself; immediately before the human authorization request, the current Greenfield authority must validate against its parent, still identify PROD-11 as the exact next action, fresh-attest all Greenfield integration prerequisites, and explicitly include PROD-11 in its current requestableActionIds under FROZEN_NOT_REQUESTED/exact-target authority semantics
currentGreenfieldAuthority.staleOrMismatchRule: any authority digest/parent mismatch, next-action drift, missing completion, failed prerequisite, non-empty conflicting requested/approved authority, or absence of PROD-11 from current requestableActionIds leaves PROD-11 blocked
